items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: They had arrangements like Jimmy Lunceford?

ctx.x: How long were you in Denmark, then?

Well, in Denmark we played there about... Oh, I don't know. Not quite a month. The picture that you see in the book Musicians Away From Home, that was at the National Scala, across from the Tivoli. At that time you had that band was playing... Kai(?) Owens. You remember Kai(?) Owens band? That was a big hit then. They had arrangements like Jimmy Lunceford?
Oh, in Denmark. Yeah, I remember them. How big a band did he have?
